verdict.rationale: Stable's virtual mailbox/address product explicitly offers package scanning, forwarding ('Ship: Forward anywhere in the world'), and mail handling (scan, deposit, shred, notify), which covers core forwarding functionality for a nomad's address. However, there is no explicit statement that the address accepts packages from all major carriers (UPS, FedEx, DHL, USPS) nor any mention of package consolidation or hold-for-pickup service. missing for 10: explicit multi-carrier acceptance policy, package consolidation feature, hold-for-pickup option.
